description: Use only for Google Calendar itself: create, list, search, inspect, update, or delete its events; list calendars; check a Google Calendar's free/busy intervals; or diagnose accounts. Never use freebusy to check availability of campsites, reservations, products, venues, appointments, or other third-party inventory.

op.description: Use start for every call; gcal finishes synchronously.

kind.description: Required with op:start. diagnose checks one selected/default account; accounts lists safe configured metadata; calendars lists calendars; list lists events; get needs calendar_id+event_id; search needs query; create needs event.summary/start/end; update needs event_id and at least one event field; delete needs event_id+confirm:true; freebusy reads busy intervals from a configured Google Calendar only and needs time_min+time_max. Fields for other kinds are rejected.

account.description: Optional configured lowercase account alias. When the original client_id/client_secret/refresh_token record and account_email exist, that authoritative record is exposed as original and overrides this field. Otherwise omit only when one account exists or an operator default is configured.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier for get/list/search/create/update/delete/freebusy. Omit for primary. Never use a display name unless it is the actual gog calendar selector returned by kind:calendars.

event_id.description: Exact event id returned by Calendar. Required for get, update, and delete; never substitute the title.

time_min.description: Absolute RFC3339 timestamp like 2026-08-01T18:00:00-05:00. Used by list/search and required by freebusy. Never send relative words such as today or tonight.

time_max.description: Absolute RFC3339 timestamp like 2026-08-02T06:00:00-05:00. Used by list/search and required by freebusy. It must be after time_min; never send relative words.

query.description: Required non-empty search text for kind:search only.

max_results.description: For list/search only, integer 1-50. Defaults to 10 for list and 25 for search.

confirm.description: Required true for kind:delete. Deletion is permanent and attendee notifications are sent. Never use for another kind.

event.description: Event fields for create/update only. create requires summary, start, and end. update changes only supplied fields; an explicitly empty description/location/attendees clears that field. Attendee changes send Google updates.

summary.description: Event title. Required and non-empty for create; optional replacement for update.

description.description: Plain event notes. An empty string on update clears existing notes.

location.description: Plain address or URL-bearing location. No place lookup occurs. An empty string on update clears it.

start.description: Absolute RFC3339 dateTime like 2026-08-01T15:00:00-05:00. Required for create. Never use a relative date or a date without timezone.

end.description: Absolute RFC3339 dateTime after start, like 2026-08-01T16:00:00-05:00. Required for create. Never use a relative date.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone such as America/Chicago, applied to start and end metadata.

attendees.description: Attendee email addresses. create invites them; update replaces the attendee list and [] clears it.
